_meta.title: Acts — key verses per chapter (King James Version, public domain)
_meta.description: Several curated key verses from each of the 28 chapters of Acts (notable teaching, promise, and pivotal narrative lines — not every verse). Ecosystem-generic 864zeros content. Each record carries the exact scripture plus an original plain-English rendering.
_meta.license: Public domain (KJV scripture); 'plain' renderings are original 864zeros writing
_meta.source: getbible.net v2 (KJV, book 44 Acts); verses verbatim, curly apostrophes normalized to straight
_meta.selection: several key verses per chapter (~1-6, scaled to chapter substance); pure narrative/travelogue filler omitted
_meta.keying: book + chapter + citation; multiple records per chapter
_meta.renderings: text = the exact KJV verse; plain = original 864zeros plain-English 2026 rendering, faithful to the verse's meaning (~grade 6-8), authored not quoted.
_meta.note: KJV New Testament renders the divine name as 'Lord'/'God' (no tetragrammaton); text is verbatim KJV. No review gate — author is reviewer.

verses.text: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
verses.plain: You'll receive power when the Holy Spirit comes on you, and you'll be my witnesses — in your own city, throughout your region, and to the ends of the earth.

verses.text: Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.
verses.plain: Why are you standing here staring at the sky? This same Jesus, who was taken up from you into heaven, will come back the same way you saw him go.

verses.text: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.
verses.plain: They all met together and gave themselves to prayer, along with the women, Mary the mother of Jesus, and his brothers.

verses.text: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
verses.plain: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other languages, as the Spirit gave them the words.

verses.text: And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God, I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:
verses.plain: In the last days, God says, I'll pour out my Spirit on everyone. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your young will see visions, and your old will dream dreams.

verses.text: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.
verses.plain: And everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.

verses.text: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.
verses.plain: Peter said, 'Turn your life around and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ, and your sins will be forgiven — and you'll receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.'

verses.text: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles' doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.
verses.plain: They devoted themselves to the apostles' teaching, to fellowship, to sharing meals, and to prayer.

verses.text: Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.
verses.plain: praising God and enjoying the goodwill of the people. And every day the Lord added to their number those who were being saved.

verses.text: Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.
verses.plain: Peter said, 'I don't have silver or gold, but what I do have, I give you: in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk.'

verses.text: And his name through faith in his name hath made this man strong, whom ye see and know: yea, the faith which is by him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.
verses.plain: It's faith in Jesus' name that has made this man strong, whom you see and know — that faith has given him complete healing right in front of you all.

verses.text: Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
verses.plain: So turn back to God and change your ways, so your sins can be wiped clean and times of refreshing can come from the Lord.

verses.text: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.
verses.plain: Salvation is found in no one else — there is no other name under heaven given to people by which we must be saved.

verses.text: For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard.
verses.plain: We can't help speaking about what we've seen and heard.

verses.text: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness.
verses.plain: After they prayed, the place where they were meeting was shaken. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke God's word boldly.

verses.text: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul: neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.
verses.plain: All the believers were one in heart and soul. No one claimed their possessions as their own; they shared everything they had.

verses.text: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.
verses.plain: Peter and the apostles answered, 'We must obey God rather than people.'

verses.text: But if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.
verses.plain: But if it's from God, you won't be able to stop it — you may even find yourselves fighting against God.

verses.text: And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.
verses.plain: They left the council rejoicing, because they'd been counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.

verses.text: But we will give ourselves continually to prayer, and to the ministry of the word.
verses.plain: But we will give ourselves fully to prayer and to the ministry of the word.

verses.text: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.
verses.plain: Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and signs among the people.

verses.text: But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
verses.plain: But Stephen, full of the Holy Spirit, looked up to heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing at God's right hand.

verses.text: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.
verses.plain: As they stoned Stephen, he prayed, 'Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.'

verses.text: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.
verses.plain: Then he fell to his knees and cried out, 'Lord, don't hold this sin against them.' And with that, he died.

verses.text: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.
verses.plain: So those who had been scattered went everywhere, sharing the good news.

verses.text: Then Philip opened his mouth, and began at the same scripture, and preached unto him Jesus.
verses.plain: Then Philip began with that very passage of scripture and told him the good news about Jesus.

verses.text: And Philip said, If thou believest with all thine heart, thou mayest. And he answered and said, I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.
verses.plain: Philip said, 'If you believe with all your heart, you may.' The man answered, 'I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.'

verses.text: And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?
verses.plain: He fell to the ground and heard a voice say to him, 'Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?'

verses.text: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:
verses.plain: But the Lord said, 'Go — this man is my chosen instrument to carry my name before the nations and their kings, and before the people of Israel.'

verses.text: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.
verses.plain: And right away he began to preach in the synagogues that Jesus is the Son of God.

verses.text: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:
verses.plain: Then Peter said, 'I truly understand now that God shows no favoritism.'

verses.text: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.
verses.plain: God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power. He went around doing good and healing all who were under the devil's power, because God was with him.

verses.text: To him give all the prophets witness, that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins.
verses.plain: Every prophet testifies about him: everyone who believes in him receives forgiveness of sins through his name.

verses.text: Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.
verses.plain: When he arrived and saw the grace of God, he was glad, and he encouraged them all to stay true to the Lord with all their hearts.

verses.text: And when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.
verses.plain: For a whole year they met with the church and taught many people. It was in Antioch that the disciples were first called Christians.

verses.text: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him.
verses.plain: So Peter was kept in prison, but the church prayed to God for him without stopping.

verses.text: And when Peter was come to himself, he said, Now I know of a surety, that the Lord hath sent his angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews.
verses.plain: When Peter came to himself, he said, 'Now I know for sure that the Lord sent his angel and rescued me from Herod's grasp.'

verses.text: As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.
verses.plain: While they were worshiping the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, 'Set apart Barnabas and Saul for the work I have called them to.'

verses.text: Be it known unto you therefore, men and brethren, that through this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins:
verses.plain: So let me be clear, friends: through this man, forgiveness of sins is offered to you.

verses.text: For so hath the Lord commanded us, saying, I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.
verses.plain: For this is what the Lord commanded us: 'I have made you a light for the nations, to bring salvation to the ends of the earth.'

verses.text: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.
verses.plain: Yet he has not left himself without a witness: he shows kindness by giving you rain from heaven and crops in their seasons, filling your hearts with food and joy.

verses.text: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.plain: They strengthened the disciples and encouraged them to remain true to the faith, saying, 'We must go through many hardships to enter God's kingdom.'

verses.text: But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved, even as they.
verses.plain: We believe it's through the grace of the Lord Jesus that we are saved, just as they are.

verses.text: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.
verses.plain: During the night Paul had a vision: a man of Macedonia stood and begged him, 'Come over to Macedonia and help us.'

verses.text: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard us: whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.
verses.plain: A woman named Lydia, a dealer in purple cloth who worshiped God, was listening. The Lord opened her heart to respond to what Paul was saying.

verses.text: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.
verses.plain: Around midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the other prisoners were listening.

verses.text: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.
verses.plain: They said, 'Believe in the Lord Jesus, and you will be saved — you and your household.'

verses.text: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.
verses.plain: These people were more open-minded than those in Thessalonica; they received the message eagerly and examined the scriptures every day to see if it was true.

verses.text: God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;
verses.plain: The God who made the world and everything in it is the Lord of heaven and earth, and he doesn't live in temples built by human hands.

verses.text: That they should seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not far from every one of us:
verses.plain: God did this so people would seek him and perhaps reach out and find him — though he is not far from any one of us.

verses.text: For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.
verses.plain: For in him we live and move and have our being. As some of your own poets have said, 'We are his offspring.'

verses.text: Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision, Be not afraid, but speak, and hold not thy peace:
verses.plain: One night the Lord spoke to Paul in a vision: 'Don't be afraid; keep speaking, and don't be silent.'

verses.text: For I am with thee, and no man shall set on thee to hurt thee: for I have much people in this city.
verses.plain: For I am with you, and no one will attack or harm you, because I have many people in this city.

verses.text: So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed.
verses.plain: So the word of the Lord spread widely and grew in power.

verses.text: But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear unto myself, so that I might finish my course with joy, and the ministry, which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.
verses.plain: But my life is worth nothing to me unless I use it to finish the work the Lord Jesus gave me — telling others the good news of God's grace.

verses.text: I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.
verses.plain: In everything I showed you that by working hard we must help the weak, remembering the words of the Lord Jesus: 'It is more blessed to give than to receive.'

verses.text: Then Paul answered, What mean ye to weep and to break mine heart? for I am ready not to be bound only, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.
verses.plain: Then Paul answered, 'Why are you weeping and breaking my heart? I'm ready not only to be bound, but to die in Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.'

verses.text: And when he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, The will of the Lord be done.
verses.plain: When he wouldn't be talked out of it, we gave up and said, 'The Lord's will be done.'

verses.text: For thou shalt be his witness unto all men of what thou hast seen and heard.
verses.plain: You will be his witness to everyone of what you have seen and heard.

verses.text: And now why tarriest thou? arise, and be baptized, and wash away thy sins, calling on the name of the Lord.
verses.plain: So why wait? Get up, be baptized, and have your sins washed away, calling on his name.

verses.text: And the night following the Lord stood by him, and said, Be of good cheer, Paul: for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem, so must thou bear witness also at Rome.
verses.plain: The next night the Lord stood by him and said, 'Take courage, Paul. Just as you have testified about me in Jerusalem, so you must also testify in Rome.'

verses.text: And herein do I exercise myself, to have always a conscience void of offence toward God, and toward men.
verses.plain: So I always work to keep my conscience clear before God and before people.

verses.text: And as he reasoned of righteousness, temperance, and judgment to come, Felix trembled, and answered, Go thy way for this time; when I have a convenient season, I will call for thee.
verses.plain: As Paul talked about right living, self-control, and the judgment to come, Felix grew afraid and said, 'That's enough for now; when it's convenient, I'll send for you.'

verses.text: For if I be an offender, or have committed any thing worthy of death, I refuse not to die: but if there be none of these things whereof these accuse me, no man may deliver me unto them. I appeal unto Cesar.
verses.plain: If I've done something worthy of death, I'm not trying to escape it. But if the charges against me are false, no one has the right to hand me over. I appeal to Caesar.

verses.text: To open their eyes, and to turn them from darkness to light, and from the power of Satan unto God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins, and inheritance among them which are sanctified by faith that is in me.
verses.plain: to open their eyes and turn them from darkness to light, and from the power of Satan to God, so they may receive forgiveness of sins and a place among those made holy by faith in me.

verses.text: Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian.
verses.plain: Then Agrippa said to Paul, 'Do you think you can make me a Christian so quickly?'

verses.text: And Paul said, I would to God, that not only thou, but also all that hear me this day, were both almost, and altogether such as I am, except these bonds.
verses.plain: Paul replied, 'Whether it takes a short time or long, I pray to God that not only you but everyone listening to me today might become what I am — except for these chains.'

verses.text: And now I exhort you to be of good cheer: for there shall be no loss of any man's life among you, but of the ship.
verses.plain: But now I urge you to take courage, because not one of you will lose your life; only the ship will be lost.

verses.text: Wherefore, sirs, be of good cheer: for I believe God, that it shall be even as it was told me.
verses.plain: So take heart, men, for I trust God that it will happen just as he told me.

verses.text: Be it known therefore unto you, that the salvation of God is sent unto the Gentiles, and that they will hear it.
verses.plain: So let it be known to you that God's salvation has been sent to the nations, and they will listen.

verses.text: Preaching the kingdom of God, and teaching those things which concern the Lord Jesus Christ, with all confidence, no man forbidding him.
verses.plain: boldly proclaiming the kingdom of God and teaching about the Lord Jesus Christ — and no one stopped him.
